description: This file contains UI rendering logic for an execution approval prompt in a web application, including functions to format remaining time, render metadata, and generate the approval dialog with actions.

methods.name: formatRemaining
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string (seconds, minutes, hours).

methods.name: renderMetaRow
methods.description: Renders a metadata row with a label and value, or returns nothing if value is null or undefined.

methods.name: renderExecBody
methods.description: Renders the main execution request details including command and session info.

methods.name: renderPluginBody
methods.description: Renders plugin-specific approval details including description and severity.

methods.name: renderExecApprovalPrompt
methods.description: Main function that renders the execution approval prompt dialog based on application state.
